## Part B Basic Types
```{r}
## 01
x <- 42
y <- 42L        # the L suffix forces an integer
z <- "42"
w <- TRUE
v <- 3+ 2i # complex number

typeof(x)
typeof(y)
typeof(z)
typeof(v)
```

```{r}

```
